note: Novo Banco's standard information sheets (Fichas de Informação Normalizada) for each of its personal credit cards, read 2026-10-30: the Verde VISA (07/2026; 13.900% a year nominal, a card fee of 13.00 euros a year), Gold VISA (07/2026; 14.600%, 25.00 euros; also sold as the Gold 360, which links the same sheet), Platinum (07/2026; 16.250%, 110.00 euros) and Branco (04/2026; 0.000% and paid in full each month, so nothing is carried; 65.00 euros a year). Each: stamp duty (IS) of 4% on interest and on the card fee, written as the tax (the 0.141% stamp duty on credit used isn't one of the game's terms and isn't written); a minimum payment of 5% of the capital owed (the Branco none, being paid in full); a recovery charge of 4% of an instalment due and unpaid, at least 12 and at most 150 euros, written as the late fee on the minimum; and late interest at the card's rate plus 3% a year, written as the penalty rate (16.9%, 17.6%, 19.25%). The card fee was written in the earlier reading of the Verde VISA (2026-10-29) as 13.52 euros with its stamp duty folded in; it is now the 13.00 fee with the 4% tax. The sheets state no cash advance or foreign transaction fee, nor a grace period. Instalment payments aren't written. The main banks: Caixa Geral de Depósitos, Millennium bcp and Novo Banco; only Novo Banco's sheets were reached on 2026-10-30. Caixa Geral de Depósitos, Portugal's largest bank, was added in wave 4: its standard information sheet for its credit cards (Ficha de Informação Normalizada, reference ICGDPT0525_20260401), read 2026-10-30. Eight cards, each at a fixed nominal rate: Caixa IN 12.80%, Caixa Classic 14.25%, Caixa ISIC 10.00% (for university students), Caixa ITIC 14.55% (for teachers; neither status is checked), Miles & More Classic and Gold 14.45%, Caixa Gold 13.75% and Platina 14.25%; the card fee (12, 18, 18, 25, 25, 60, 50 and 90 euros), which the sheet's 12-month examples include once, written as a yearly fee. Each: stamp duty of 4% on interest and on fees, written as the tax (the 0.141% on credit used isn't one of the game's terms); a minimum payment of 3% of the capital owed (10% on the Platina), at least 25 euros (12 on the ISIC), plus interest, taxes and charges; late interest at the card's rate plus 3%, written as the penalty rate; a recovery charge of 4% of an instalment due and unpaid, at least 12 and at most 150 euros, written as the late fee on the minimum. The sheet states no cash advance or foreign transaction fee. The Miles & More cards' fixed-instalment option and the Pagamentos Fracionados line aren't written. Banco Santander Totta, among Portugal's three largest banks, was added in wave 4 as the third bank (Millennium bcp wasn't tried): the standard information sheets (MOD. 086, 01/07/2026) for its Cartão de Crédito Gold and Cartão Platinum, the two whose sheets were found at its site's addresses, read 2026-10-30 (the Classic and other guessed addresses answered 404). The Gold bears 11.80% a year and costs 72 euros a year, paid as 6 euros a month (written monthly); the Platinum 13.30% and 150 euros a year, paid as 37.50 a quarter (written quarterly). Each: the least partial payment is 5% of the balance, at least 25 euros (50 on the Platinum), with interest and taxes; late interest at the rate plus the legal maximum surcharge of 3%, written as the penalty rate (14.80% and 16.30%); a recovery charge of 4% of an instalment due and unpaid, at least 12 and at most 150 euros, written as the late fee on the minimum; stamp duty of 4% on interest and on fees, written as the tax (the 0.141% a month on credit used isn't written). The 1.5% PagaSIMPLES instalment plans aren't written; the sheets' cash and currency charges weren't read.
